description: Update an existing Scheduled Maintenance State in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_scheduled_maintenance_state afterwards to see the updated record.

color.description: Color of this resource in Hex (#32a852 for example).

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Scheduled Maintenance State to update. Required. Use list_scheduled_maintenance_states to find IDs.

isArchived.description: Archived states stay on the maintenance events that are in them, but can't be picked again. The scheduled, ongoing, ended and completed states can't be archived.

isEndedState.description: Is this state a ended state?

isOngoingState.description: Is this state a ongoing state?

isResolvedState.description: Is this state a resolved state?

isScheduledState.description: Is this state a scheduled state?

name.description: Any friendly name of this object.

order.description: Where this state sits in the project's list of scheduled maintenance states: 1 is the top. Events only ever move down the list, so the scheduled, ongoing, ended and completed states have to stay in that order. A new state without a number goes just above the completed state. Setting a number moves the state to that place, and the ones in between shift by one. In the dashboard, drag the rows to reorder them.

name: update_scheduled_maintenance_state
title: Update Scheduled Maintenance State
